column1: # Omarchy keys on KDE Plasma 5 and 6 (kglobalshortcutsrc). Same columns as keys.tsv:
#   key | action | kind:target
#   kwin:<name>          KWin action in group [kwin]
#   tile:<p5>;<p6>       Krohnkite action: its Plasma 5 name ; its Plasma 6 name (group [kwin])
#   ksm:<name>           [ksmserver] action      shell:<name>   [plasmashell] action
#   layout:<name>        [KDE Keyboard Layout Switcher] action
#   svc:<desktop file>   the service's _launch key (KRunner, emoji picker)
#   custom:<command>     own launcher (~/.local/share/applications/work-kit-desk-*.desktop)
#   kde:<note>           Plasma already does this with its default key (listed for Super+K)
#   none:<reason>        not available on Plasma
# "DIGIT" expands to workspaces 1..9 and 0 (= 10), limited to the configured count.
# PLUS is Omarchy's Super+= key: "=" with a US layout, the "+" key with a German one (there "=" is
# Shift+0, which KWin sees as Meta+= and would clash with Super+Shift+0). kde_accel writes the keys
# of the layout active at the Plasma login (kb_layout), shifted symbols by the symbol they type
# (US Super+Shift+= is Meta++, German Super+Shift++ is Meta+*); `kit-desk keys` names the keys.
SUPER + RETURN|Terminal|custom:@BIN@/kit-desk term
SUPER + ALT + RETURN|Terminal with tmux|custom:@BIN@/kit-desk term --tmux
SUPER + SHIFT + RETURN|Browser|custom:@BIN@/kit-desk browser
SUPER + SHIFT + B|Browser|custom:@BIN@/kit-desk browser
SUPER + SHIFT + ALT + B|Browser (private)|custom:@BIN@/kit-desk browser --private
SUPER + SHIFT + F|File manager|custom:@BIN@/kit-desk files
SUPER + SHIFT + N|Editor (nvim)|custom:@BIN@/kit-desk editor
SUPER + CTRL + T|Activity (btop)|custom:@BIN@/kit-desk term -e btop
SUPER + K|Show keybindings|custom:@BIN@/kit-desk keys --window
SUPER + SHIFT + CTRL + SPACE|Theme menu|custom:@BIN@/kit-desk term -e @BIN@/kit-desk theme
SUPER + ESCAPE|System menu: lock, log out, power off|custom:@BIN@/kit-desk power
SUPER + ALT + SPACE|Kit menu: settings, keys, theme, system|custom:@BIN@/kit-desk menu
SUPER + SPACE|Launcher (KRunner: apps and files)|svc:org.kde.krunner.desktop
SUPER|Application menu|super:Meta alone opens the launcher menu
ALT + F2|Run a command (KRunner)|kde:KRunner default key

SUPER + F|Full screen|kwin:Window Fullscreen
SUPER + ALT + F|Maximize|kwin:Window Maximize
SUPER + O|Keep above other windows|kwin:Window Above Other Windows
SUPER + T|Toggle floating|tile:Krohnkite: Float;KrohnkiteToggleFloat
SUPER + LEFT|Focus left|tile:Krohnkite: Left;KrohnkiteFocusLeft
SUPER + RIGHT|Focus right|tile:Krohnkite: Right;KrohnkiteFocusRight
SUPER + UP|Focus up|tile:Krohnkite: Up/Prev;KrohnkiteFocusUp

SUPER + J|Rotate layout (split direction)|tile:Krohnkite: Rotate;KrohnkiteRotate
SUPER + CTRL + F|Monocle: one window fills the screen|tile:Krohnkite: Monocle Layout;KrohnkiteMonocleLayout
SUPER + MINUS|Narrower window|tile:Krohnkite: Shrink Width;KrohnkiteShrinkWidth
SUPER + PLUS|Wider window|tile:Krohnkite: Grow Width;KrohnkitegrowWidth
SUPER + SHIFT + MINUS|Lower window|tile:Krohnkite: Shrink Height;KrohnkiteShrinkHeight
